dct_creator_sm: Maire, Vincent (Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3245-2568
dct_description_sm: This study investigated how 66 arctic tundra bryophyte communities respond to soil water, nutrient availability (nitrogen, N, and phosphorus, P), and herbivory across two distinct contexts: a long-term geomorphological gradient and a 15-year NP enrichment experiment. We measured eleven functional traits at the individual level on 28 dominant bryophyte species to decompose the community response into contributions from species turnover, abundance shifts, and intraspecific variability.
dct_title_s: Bryophyte trait, Community matrix, and Environmental conditions of wet and mesic vegetation in high-arctic tundra (Bylot Island, Nunavut, Canada)
